purpose: Resident/indexed temporal semantic substrate with evidence-bounded active assemblies and query-adaptive graph escalation; exact/event stores remain authoritative.

layers.role: versioned pointers/witnesses to authoritative exact state/events; no duplicate authority
preloaded semantic/provenance graph plus lexical/id/status/evidence-family indexes; no per-query full JSONL reload
choose direct exact, packet/FTS, graph-local or graph-multihop route from query requirements and uncertainty
transient bounded graph expansion only when route requires it
replayable explanation of route, evidence families, paths, exact anchors, conflicts, stop reason and cost

MIXED.rule: exact subclaims validate against anchors; associative subclaims may graph-escalate

resident_index_contract.update: incremental from authoritative changefeed/repository delta when closure is known; deterministic rebuild fallback when unknown or integrity check fails
resident_index_contract.hot_path_rule: query must not parse/reload the complete node/edge corpus
resident_index_contract.integrity: resident index carries source_corpus_hash + graph_revision + rebuild/last_delta receipt

rules: do not graph-escalate a query already answered by exact/packet baseline with sufficient confidence unless audit requires relation tracing
qualified edge type alone never authorizes expansion
target needs query relevance or explicit bridge role
stop when marginal evidence gain falls below cost threshold or budget is reached
preserve conflicting alternatives rather than average them
graph_escalation_gate.fallback: return baseline retrieval plus unresolved-relation marker rather than forcing graph traversal

reader_projection.principle: semantic canonical form and model-facing form are distinct
reader_projection.small_model_rule: prefer explicit role-labelled relation projections over aggressively compact positional encodings until target reader tests prove otherwise
reader_projection.context_compression: deduplicate textual descendants while preserving distinct functional roles and evidence-family ancestry
reader_projection.authority: projection can influence reasoning but never mint truth/effect authority

frank_mapping.M.MEMORY_FABRIC: owns retrieval router/resident semantic index/assembly generation
frank_mapping.M.WORKSPACE_ARBITER: consumes memory candidate only after assembly; graph activation is not GWT ignition
frank_mapping.M.CAPABILITY_GATEWAY: remains sole hard external effect authority

migration.rule: retrieval performance never authorizes physical migration; store migration still requires shadow parity/replay/p99/crash/privacy/rollback evidence

hard_invariants: resident cache is derived and rebuildable
exact/current claims validate against authoritative anchors
shared ancestry is not independent replication
no secrets/bearer capabilities in graph/model context
graph route is optional and budgeted

evidence_boundary.local_index_proxy: resident/inverted seed indexing strongly improves synthetic lookup cost but target transfer unproven
evidence_boundary.external: adaptive graph routing independently supported as a current research direction
